purpose: Require V2 to control false positives under stationary noise, monotonic drift, and a genuinely reversible decline-recovery threshold cycle, while recovering a deliberately history-dependent threshold cycle.

stationary_exogenous_events.description: Stationary AR(1) parent abundance with a fixed completed spell unrelated to parent state.

monotonic_drift_exogenous_events.description: Smoothly increasing parent abundance with the same fixed spell; tests generic later-is-higher drift.

reversible_threshold_cycle.description: Parent abundance declines and recovers; occupancy is generated by one identical loss/recovery threshold, so abandonment and recolonization are genuinely reversible.

hysteresis_threshold_moderate.description: State-machine occupancy uses a higher recolonization threshold than abandonment threshold by a moderate amount.

hysteresis_threshold_strong.description: State-machine occupancy uses a substantially higher recolonization threshold than abandonment threshold.

decision: V2 may be preregistered only if all four pass thresholds are met. Failure closes V2 before any SMP magnitude outcome is opened.
